summary: All three piece counts are integers capped at 50, so the complete legal input domain has a fixed bound and cannot support an honest asymptotic scaling experiment for the constant-time arithmetic solution.

replacement_checks.evidence: The closed form performs one minimum, fixed-factor multiplication, one comparison, at most one increment, one addition, and one final multiplication regardless of the input values.
Authored cases cover all counts at their minima and maxima, equal AA/BB counts, extreme surplus on either side, and an AB-heavy input.
